newsitem.title: USA: High pressure building in Brazil coffee belt - WSC.
newsitem.headline: High pressure building in Brazil coffee belt - WSC.

text.p: Warm, high pressure building in Brazil's coffee belt is expected to produce a long period of mild temperatures in the region, Weather Services Corp said in an update Tuesday.
According to WSC, the high pressure system is expected to warm the coffee belt over the next seven days.
Partly cloudy skies and below normal temperatures were seen throughout the region this morning. Low temperatures ranged from 46-54 F (8-12 C).

Partly cloudy skies will continue for the rest of today. Partly to variably cloudy skies and a few light showers are expected for Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. Temperatures should remain near normal levels with lows in the 50's F (low to middle teens C).
The extended outlook calls for fair to partly cloudy skies through the weekend with temperatures remaining near to above normal.
